preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard n must be between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n)) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The list p must contain exactly n integers, each between 1 and n, with no duplicates.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not solution_exists else True
postconditions.description: If no valid partition exists, output -1; otherwise, output the partition.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == i + 1 for i, line in enumerate(output_lines))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must contain the correct number of elements corresponding to its row index.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in line) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: All numbers in the output must be valid region identifiers between 1 and n.
